rule: D47 rule 4: on the page's cohort, the page's own search (matchPatient) under main's view (grouped by the generator's truth) and this tree's (reconcile_v1), for the five templates under stated findings, coded only and hedged findings, and every option-sweep definition under its own setting and under hedged findings. Each changed result is classified by the regroupings that make its step candidates differ, each verified on the two views. Met only if no changed result is unexplained, and the windows and the store requests are the same on both sides for every case

classes.merged: an event here holds records or mentions of several of main's events
classes.split: records or mentions of one of main's events are in several events here
classes.regrouped: held by one event on each side, with another set of records or mentions
classes.mention-only: an event of letter mentions only, held by one event on the other side with another set
classes.ungrouped: the other side has no event holding these records or mentions (a record it could not place; a mention it does not take)
classes.series: a measurement step's readings differ, and so does the series it reads
classes.reranked: the same event on both sides, picked (first, last, Nth, the count reached) on one only, the step's events before the pick differing
classes.reordered: the same events, in another order or with other times

view_cost.rule: reported, not ruled (D47 rule 7): node, one process, after the census

synthetic_patient_ids: generator ids only (as the parity test pins them)
